objective: Assess a long-lived connection using exact duration, transfer, role, peer, and application context while accounting for Zeek duration semantics and avoiding duration-only malicious verdicts.
preconditions: a trusted connection anchor and bounded time envelope exist
originator responder or event-native roles are attributable
deployed flow and timeline field catalogs are available
required_evidence: duration start tuple state bytes packets and correlation identity
peer ownership protocol application and expected-use context
sensor coverage termination semantics and evidence references
positive_evidence: an attributable long-lived session has transfer and peer behavior inconsistent with its approved application
cross-sensor evidence corroborates tunneling remote-shell or exfiltration hypotheses
negative_evidence: successful covered context attributes the duration and transfer to an approved persistent service
connection state capture coverage and peer ownership support normal administration replication or messaging
escalation_pivots: correlate the exact connection with bounded DNS TLS alert and endpoint context
verify capture start termination and Zeek duration limitations
obtain application-owner confirmation before escalating duration alone

query_templates.purpose: Retrieve the exact bounded connection summary with duration transfer and role-safe tuple semantics.
Correlate bounded alert protocol DNS and endpoint context before interpreting the long-lived session.

alternative_hypotheses: approved VPN remote administration or persistent application session
large backup synchronization or media transfer
idle keepalive or incomplete termination visibility
malicious tunnel remote shell or exfiltration channel
stop_conditions: duration transfer peer and application context discriminate the hypotheses
termination or capture semantics remain unavailable and are reported explicitly
the next bounded context pivot has low expected information value
a query budget or deadline is exhausted
confidence_limiters: Zeek duration excludes trailing nonproductive packets
connection state or byte counts are incomplete
process application or peer ownership unavailable
known_false_positive_patterns: SSH administration and tunnels approved by policy
database message queue and websocket connections
